A repro at current main (46595c87), prebuilt dist via 'spex serve ui' :18922 over an isolated loopback backend :18921 (throwaway repo, SPEXCODE_HOME + SPEXCODE_ISSUES_DIR). Viewer sits on the issue thread's DETAIL page; POST /api/remarks lands from outside the tab. Controls both hold: the store persists it (GET /api/issues/<id> 200 with the remark) and a fresh load renders it. The already-open viewer NEVER shows it — >30s, twice the cold lane the expected forbids. Path capture: the SERVER leg is intact (notifyBoardChanged('full') atomic with persist; issuesStamp moved 2:2:1->2:2:2 and a graph-delta meta patch shipped 22ms after the write). The CLIENT never consumes that stamp: grep issuesStamp over spec-dashboard/src is EMPTY. The paged list survives only incidentally (refreshKey: sessions — board-frame identity churn; measured 1.29s), while useIssueDetail subscribes to nothing at all and has no poll.

B on a clean committed tree (d95f42dc), same rig and same probe as the A repro: prebuilt dist rebuilt from HEAD and served by 'spex serve ui' :18922 over an isolated loopback backend :18921 (throwaway repo, SPEXCODE_HOME + SPEXCODE_ISSUES_DIR), viewer parked on the issue thread's DETAIL page, remark landing from outside the tab via POST /api/remarks. Already-open viewer shows it in 0.54s (one debounce + rebuild + read) vs never-within-30s in A. Both controls still hold: persistence 200 with the remark, fresh load renders it. The client leg now exists — App hands board.issuesStamp to both shells, the paged list keys the stamp plus the presence join instead of the sessions array's per-frame identity, and useIssueDetail re-reads on a stamp tick while only a new address wipes it to loading.

Same rig, clean committed tree (d95f42dc): browser warm-enters the board on #/issues then navigates to the reading detail #/evals/demo/rig-scenario; a scenario-hosted remark lands from outside the tab via POST /api/remarks (node+scenario host).
